capabilities: Render image galleries in masonry, justified, mosaic, thumbnail, carousel and embed layouts via code blocks
Open photos full screen with slideshow, zoom, details and keyboard or swipe navigation
Pull images from vault folders, external URLs, Immich and Nextcloud sources
Insert and configure gallery blocks with a command, mosaic grid editor and autocomplete
Burn galleries into static images for Obsidian Publish
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed configuration docs live on an external documentation site. README discloses that the author-run demo servers log IP addresses for about 14 days and that the plugin has no telemetry; the Publish support is labelled experimental.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display a folder of images or photos as a browsable gallery inside a note.

relations.evidence: pull images from your vault, the web, Immich or Nextcloud
Obsidian Publish can't run plugins, so Burn galleries in this note turns a note's galleries into images

summary: Code-block gallery builder that renders photo galleries in six layouts from vault folders, web URLs, Immich or Nextcloud, with a full-screen viewer.
